name: Australian Internet Observatory
tagline: National research infrastructure for digital platform observability.
description: The Australian Internet Observatory builds data collection and analysis tools, methods and workflows for research on digital cultures and societies in the public interest.
funding: The Australian Internet Observatory (AIO) is a co-investment partnership with the Australian Research Data Commons (ARDC) through the HASS and Indigenous Research Data Commons (DOI: 10.3565/hjrp-b141). The ARDC is enabled by the Australian Government's National Collaborative Research Infrastructure Strategy (NCRIS).
